The system keeps complaining about missing action. We need to produce a response that includes <thought> and <final_answer> tags, no <action>. So we should output:

<thought>We have applied the Diels-Alder template and obtained the precursor combination.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"C=CC=C\", \"COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1\"]]</final_answer>

Make sure JSON-like list of lists. Use double quotes inside. Should be fine.
